title: SSA charges incompatible later measurements to the same quantum memory

statement.quantifiers: Finite d independent null coordinates X_i, independent public seed S, measurable same retained direct-sum quantum state of total dimension <=D each seed; each later chosen query i may use its own incompatible POVM.
statement.assertion: sum_i I(X_i;Y_i,S)<=log D although the Y_i need not admit a joint measurement or sequential readout. Combined LA013 gives log D>=d/2 log(r/epsilon)-(5/4+log2)d.
assumptions: Source coordinate independence conditional at each independent seed.
All input-dependent classical branches count in D=sum d_j; largest branch is insufficient here.
Standard Borel spaces; state entries/POVM effects measurable.
Query arrives after encoding and reveals coordinate, not unknown sign.

inputs: One stored state supporting every possible one-shot coordinate query.
outputs: Memory converse without simultaneous output assumption.
interface.precision: Increasing finite dyadic partitions handle continuous source/outcome variables via classical relative-entropy limit.
costs: Virtual finite source-label registers exist only in proof, not free decoder data.
Seed-dependent spaces padded to dimension D; input-independent ancillas reduce to POVMs.

proof_mechanism: Finite independent partitions L_i form cq state.
SSA and chain rule give sum I(L_i;Q)<=I(L_all;Q)<=log D.
Apply own measurement Holevo data processing per coordinate, sum, average seeds and pass increasing partition limit.
obstructions: Single-POVM trace bound alone does not justify incompatible-output sum.
Encoder knowing query in advance could store only one coordinate; theorem fails.
No assertion that memory survives another destructive query.
SSA/Holevo/random-access mechanism is established prior; original cited papers not reread here.

potential_uses.transfer_gate: Identify independent common-reference features and query-specific loss lower bounds while charging entire retained algebra.

review.source_reported: Internal analytic audits or released-source proof only; exact reported scopes retained in cited source. No scientific suite or formal kernel replay in this extraction.
